trade_rules_of_thumb: Scale is 1-100 Superflex Half-PPR 10-team. Keep it every day. 90+ is 1.01-1.04, 75-89 late 1st/early 2nd, 55-74 is a 2nd.
Starting QBs are premium. A locked QB2 beats a skill-player WR3 in this format.
Do not treat this like 1QB. Two startable QBs > one elite WR if you would otherwise stream junk.
